openai_gpt4o.readability_at_game_size: Strategy B: Public-Library CC0 PBR textures provide the highest readability at the native resolution of 426x240 due to their detailed and realistic texture scans.
openai_gpt4o.late_90s_cg_style: Strategy B: Public-Library CC0 PBR textures feel most like an expensive late-90s pre-rendered CG set, reminiscent of games like Vagrant Story and FFIX.
openai_gpt4o.fake_or_uniform_surfaces: Strategy A: Procedural Blender shaders tend to look fake or overly uniform, especially in the stone wall and plaster facade.
openai_gpt4o.flat_or_contaminated_surfaces: Strategy C: OpenAI-Generated textures suffer from flatness and directional-light/highlight contamination, particularly noticeable in the cobblestone and wood textures.
openai_gpt4o.height_map_usefulness: The generated height/displacement map in Strategy C is less useful compared to the procedural bump in Strategy A and scanned normal maps in Strategy B, which provide more realistic depth and detail.
openai_gpt4o.recommended_strategy: Strategy B: Public-Library CC0 PBR textures are recommended as the winning production vocabulary due to their superior realism and alignment with the desired late-90s pre-rendered CG aesthetic.
